ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely high ratio of low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels to high-intensity (white) pixels, with the surface being approximately 95% dark pigment punctuated by 5% bright scarification nodes.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant black pigment across the entire fluke surface; discrete white circular nodes and rings (rosettes) are mapped in the central-medial zone and at the distal tips of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with an estimated internal angle of 60-70 degrees; the depression depth is approximately 1/6th of the vertical fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations visible along the entire continuous trailing edge; pixel-amplitude of peaks varies between 10 to 25 pixels, creating a jagged boundary profile.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetric convex curves extending from the medial notch, sweeping upwards and outwards into sharp, posteriorly-pointed distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly distinct cluster of roughly 8-12 white circular ring scars located in the center-left quadrant; additional isolated rings are scattered across the mid-right lobe surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, unaligned white linear markings visible on the lower section of the left lobe and lower-medial section of the right lobe near the waterline.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive circular scarring (likely lamprey or cookiecutter shark bites) and dense calcified barnacle clusters localized specifically on the lateral-most tips of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced jagged indentation/notch on the trailing edge of the left lobe, approximately two-thirds of the way toward the tip, distinct from standard serrations.
